notes.title: Update Notes 2/3/2020
notes.content:
We have released a new version of Wizardry: Labyrinth of Lost Souls.
Build Number: 4637633

We have received reports that the wrong save data was being loaded by the autosave file.

This update addresses this issue, and as long as the autosave file was not manually
edited by the user, it should load the correct data. Please let us know if you still have issues with the save data.

This update addresses the following issues:
-Game reads incorrect save data as most recent when loading the autosave file
-Words for "Attack target" and "attack method" swapped for some Japanese battle messages
-Mouse cannot be used to back out of the Explore menu
-Using a mouse for guild trades causes the wrong item to be received
-Mouse cannot be used to cast spells outside of the battle menu

[i]This update has also been released on GOG (Version 1.0.14).[/i]

notes.title: Update Notes 1/27/2020
notes.content:
We have released a new version of Wizardry: Labyrinth of Lost Souls.
Build Number: 4611228

This build fixes the following issue:
-"Wish" spell displays the same three choices regardless of effect. With the fix, all five potential choices now have a chance of appearing, as intended.
Issues we are still looking into:
-Attack target and method swapped for some Japanese battle messages

[i]This update has also been released on GOG (Version 1.0.9)[/i]

notes.title: Update Notes 1/22/2020
notes.content:
We have released a new version of Wizardry: Labyrinth of Lost Souls.
Build Number (Steam): 4595270

This build implements the following features:
-Mouse control functionality added to the following sub-menus: treasure chests, spells, item identification.
-"Toggle" for Turbo Mode has been added to the Settings menu. This function will allow you to toggle the mode on and off by pressing the assigned button/key. "Hold" is still available as an option.
-Auto-battle mode restored to the game. Default controls: Activate "auto-battle" by holding R2/Shift and holding down the confirm key.

[i]This updated has also been released on GOG (Version 1.0.8).[/i]
